title: Update a Community installation to the latest release
purpose: Keeps a Community (free) PIM Manager installation on the latest release: it fetches the public GitHub clone, says which version it would move to, and only with -Apply pulls it (fast-forward only) and re-runs the deploy with the parameters the last successful deploy saved.
whenToRun: On your own schedule, for a Community installation (the Community edition has no in-cloud updater). It is part of the release, not a separate download: run it from the clone of the public GitHub repository you installed from (.\tools\setup\Update-PimCommunity.ps1), as the person who ran the original deploy. A Pro installation updates itself in the cloud and does not use this script.

runAs.name: The same rights as the original deploy (Invoke-PimDeployAll.ps1): Owner of the PIM resource group or subscription, signed in through the browser (no Azure CLI)
runAs.scope: the PIM resource group and subscription
runAs.why: The update re-runs the deploy with the saved parameters; every step that is already current is skipped, so in practice it rolls the new version and upgrades the schema. The deploy's own page lists each right.

changes.object: the GitHub clone (git pull --ff-only) -- only with -Apply and when the clone is behind; a clone with local changes to tracked files is refused
changes.why: Brings the code to the latest release. Never a merge.
changes.undo: git -C <clone> reset to the previous release tag, then run the deploy again.

changes.object: the PIM Manager / engine containers, the database schema (additive) and any step the deploy finds out of date -- only with -Apply
changes.why: Rolls the new version. The schema is upgraded additively before the new version starts, and a failed health check rolls the Manager back.
changes.undo: Check out the previous release in the clone and run the update (or the deploy) again with -SkipPull.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.help: Which saved deploy profile to use when there is more than one on this machine.

parameters.name: ProfilePath
parameters.help: A saved deploy profile to use directly (written by a successful Invoke-PimDeployAll.ps1 -Apply).

parameters.name: SkipPull
parameters.help: Re-run the deploy on the code you already have (no fetch, no pull).

parameters.name: Apply
parameters.help: Pull and deploy. Without it nothing changes: the target version is reported and the deploy plan printed.

readsOnly: the clone's VERSION file and its upstream (git fetch, git rev-list) to report from -> to
network: github.com (git fetch / pull of the public repository)
login.microsoftonline.com, management.azure.com, graph.microsoft.com and the PIM resources (the re-run deploy; see Invoke-PimDeployAll)
whatIf: Reads the saved profile and reports the version; does not fetch or pull ('What if: would fetch the clone's upstream ... skipped'); runs the deploy as a -WhatIf plan ('DEPLOY-ALL PLAN (WHATIF ...', 'WHATIF / PLAN-ONLY -- no changes made'). -WhatIf wins over -Apply. Nothing is changed.
undo: Check out the previous release in the clone (git checkout <previous tag>) and run the update again with -SkipPull -Apply; the deploy rolls that version back in.
